sections.title: Day 17 學習概覽
sections.markdown:
今天接續 Day 16，進入第三週第二階段：**Part 3 意圖／暗示推論**，文法主題是 **不定代名詞 `someone / anyone / everyone / no one / something / anything / nothing`**。

目前沒有收到 Day 16 的實際答題結果，因此維持 **860～900 分難度**。今天開始刻意減少 Listening 的原字重現，訓練你從語境判斷「說話者真正想表達什麼」。建議訓練 **90～100 分鐘**。

sections.title: ② 今日文法｜someone / anyone
sections.markdown:
`someone` 通常表示：

> **某人**

常見於肯定句：

> Someone left a message for you.

`anyone` 常見於疑問、否定與條件句：

> Did anyone call?

> I didn't see anyone.

> If anyone has questions, please contact me.

但這不是絕對規則。

例如：

> Would anyone like some coffee?

仍然可以使用 `anyone`。

TOEIC 最重要的是理解語意，而不是死背「肯定 some、否定 any」。

---

sections.title: ③ everyone / no one
sections.markdown:
> Everyone **is** required to attend.

注意：

`everyone` 雖然代表很多人，文法上視為：

**單數。**

所以：

> Everyone are ❌

> Everyone is ✅

同樣：

> Someone **has** called.

> No one **knows** the answer.

---

sections.title: ④ something / anything / nothing
sections.markdown:
與人的邏輯類似：

> I have **something** to tell you.

> Do you need **anything**?

> We don't need **anything** else.

> **Nothing** has changed.

注意：

`nothing` 本身已經是否定。

所以標準英文不要寫：

> We don't need nothing. ❌

應該：

> We don't need anything.

或：

> We need nothing.

---

sections.title: ⑤ 不定代名詞 + 形容詞
sections.markdown:
這是 TOEIC 很值得記的語序。

中文會說：

「重要的事情」

英文：

> **something important**

不是：

> important something ❌

同樣：

> something useful  
> anything unusual  
> nothing serious  
> someone qualified

形容詞放在不定代名詞：

> **後面**

---

sections.title: ⑥ everyone vs. every one
sections.markdown:
不要混淆。

> **everyone**

= everybody，所有人。

而：

> **every one of the products**

= 每一個產品。

例如：

> Everyone **is** invited.

> Every one of the machines **was** inspected.

兩者都通常搭配單數動詞，但意思不同。

---

sections.title: ⑦ Part 3 今日核心｜意圖推論
sections.markdown:
正式 TOEIC 常出現：

> What does the man imply when he says, “...” ?

這不是問：

「這句話字面翻譯是什麼？」

而是：

> **他為什麼在這個情境講這句？**

例如：

A：

> Can you finish the report today?

B：

> I have three client meetings this afternoon.

字面：

> 我下午有三場客戶會議。

真正暗示：

> **今天可能無法完成報告。**

這就是今天的核心能力。

---

sections.title: ⑧ Listening｜Part 3 對話一
sections.markdown:
先看題目。

### Q1

What are the speakers discussing?

(A) A job interview  
(B) A customer complaint  
(C) A hotel reservation  
(D) A product shipment

### Q2

What problem does the woman mention?

(A) A candidate canceled  
(B) A meeting room is occupied  
(C) A résumé is missing  
(D) A manager is absent

### Q3

What does the man imply when he says, “Room 4B should be free after two”?

(A) He wants to cancel the interviews  
(B) Another room may be available later  
(C) He will leave work at two  
(D) The candidates are late

聽力稿：

> **Woman:** We have three candidate interviews this afternoon, but Conference Room 2 is being used for a training session.
>
> **Man:** What time is the first interview?
>
> **Woman:** Two thirty. I checked Room 3A, but it's reserved all afternoon.
>
> **Man:** Room 4B should be free after two. I'll confirm it with reception.

答案：

**1A / 2B / 3B**

Q3 不要只翻譯：

> 4B 兩點後應該有空。

真正意圖：

> **建議改用 Room 4B。**

---

sections.title: ⑨ Listening｜Part 3 對話二
sections.markdown:
### Q1

Who most likely is the woman?

(A) A job applicant  
(B) A customer  
(C) A hotel employee  
(D) A delivery driver

### Q2

Why is she calling?

(A) To reschedule an interview  
(B) To request a salary increase  
(C) To submit an expense report  
(D) To cancel an order

### Q3

What does the man imply when he says, “Thursday afternoon is still open”?

(A) No interviews will be held Thursday  
(B) The interview can probably be moved  
(C) The company has filled the position  
(D) The office will close Thursday

聽力稿：

> **Woman:** Hello, I'm scheduled to interview for the marketing position Wednesday morning. Unfortunately, my flight has been changed, and I won't arrive until Wednesday afternoon.
>
> **Man:** Let me check the interview schedule. Thursday afternoon is still open.
>
> **Woman:** That would work perfectly. Thank you.

答案：

**1A / 2A / 3B**

這就是高頻模式：

> is still open

在行程語境：

> **還有空檔**

不一定是「門還開著」。

---

sections.title: ⑩ Listening｜Part 3 對話三
sections.markdown:
### Q1

What are the speakers discussing?

(A) Employee training  
(B) Office equipment  
(C) Advertising costs  
(D) Customer refunds

### Q2

What problem does the man mention?

(A) He missed registration  
(B) The training course is full  
(C) He lost a document  
(D) His supervisor is unavailable

### Q3

What does the woman mean when she says, “There's another session next Tuesday”?

(A) The employee can attend on another date  
(B) Tuesday's session has been canceled  
(C) Training is no longer required  
(D) Registration is unnecessary

聽力稿：

> **Man:** I tried to register for Friday's safety training, but the system says there are no seats available.
>
> **Woman:** Yes, that session filled up yesterday.
>
> **Man:** I need to complete the training before the end of the month.
>
> **Woman:** There's another session next Tuesday, and I believe it still has several openings.

答案：

**1A / 2B / 3A**

Listening 筆記只需要：

> training → Friday full → Tuesday available

---

sections.title: ⑪ Reading｜Part 7
sections.markdown:
今天限時 **3 分 30 秒**。

> **To:** All Department Managers  
> **From:** Human Resources  
> **Subject:** Supervisor Training Program
>
> Everyone who was recently promoted to a supervisory position is required to complete the company's new management training program.
>
> The program consists of three online courses and one in-person workshop. Participants may complete the online courses at any time before October 20. However, everyone must attend the workshop scheduled for October 23.
>
> Anyone who is unable to attend the workshop should contact Human Resources as soon as possible. Another workshop may be arranged in November if enough employees request one.
>
> Before attending the workshop, participants should complete all three online courses. Each course takes approximately 45 minutes.
>
> Additional information about the program is available on the employee portal. If you notice anything incorrect in your registration information, please notify Human Resources immediately.

### Q1

Who is required to complete the program?

(A) All employees  
(B) Recently promoted supervisors  
(C) Job applicants  
(D) Customers

### Q2

How many online courses are included?

(A) One  
(B) Two  
(C) Three  
(D) Four

### Q3

When is the in-person workshop scheduled?

(A) October 20  
(B) October 23  
(C) November 3  
(D) November 20

### Q4

What should someone do if unable to attend?

(A) Contact Human Resources  
(B) Resign from the program  
(C) Contact a customer  
(D) Repeat the online courses

### Q5

Under what condition might another workshop be offered?

(A) If the first workshop is canceled  
(B) If enough employees request it  
(C) If managers approve a new budget  
(D) If the online courses are delayed

### Q6

What should participants do before attending the workshop?

(A) Complete three online courses  
(B) Submit a résumé  
(C) Conduct an interview  
(D) Request a promotion

### Q7

The word **“anything”** in the final paragraph refers to:

(A) any thing or detail  
(B) every employee  
(C) a specific manager  
(D) no information

**答案：1B / 2C / 3B / 4A / 5B / 6A / 7A**

注意：

> **Anyone who is unable...**

`Anyone` 是單數，所以：

> anyone **is**

不是 `are`。

sections.title: ⑭ 今日解析
sections.markdown:
Q2：

> didn't find _____

句子本身已有否定：

> didn't

所以使用：

> **anything**

不要：

> didn't find nothing ❌

---

Q3：

> someone _____

需要修飾 someone。

不定代名詞後：

> **形容詞**

所以：

> someone **experienced**

---

Q4：

> Everyone ... _____ required

`everyone` 文法上：

**單數**

所以：

> **is required**

---

Q9 是今天 Listening 最重要的一題。

> Thursday afternoon is still open.

不能只翻成：

「星期四下午仍然是開的。」

根據上下文：

> interview schedule

因此：

> open = **available**

真正意思：

> **星期四下午還有可安排面試的時段。**

這就是 TOEIC 860+ 很重要的「語境義」。

---

sections.title: ⑯ 今日作業
sections.markdown:
今天先複習十組 HR 搭配：

> qualified candidate  
> fill a vacancy  
> apply for a position  
> meet the qualifications  
> conduct an interview  
> work experience  
> employee orientation  
> receive a promotion  
> performance review  
> professional reference

文法則直接形成四個反射：

> someone → 某人

> anyone → 任何人／有人

> everyone → 所有人，但 **單數動詞**

> no one → 沒有人，而且 **單數動詞**

以及：

> something **important**

> anything **unusual**

> someone **qualified**

記住形容詞放在不定代名詞**後面**。

Listening 作業不要重新逐字翻譯三段對話，只寫：

> **D1：interviews → room unavailable → Room 4B**

> **D2：interview → flight changed → Thursday**

> **D3：training → Friday full → Tuesday**

接著每段自己回答：

> **Problem?**

> **Solution?**

> **Next action?**

最後重新完成 Day 17 小考，第二次限制 **2 分鐘 15 秒**，目標 **10/10**。

如果今天達到 **9～10/10**，後續 Listening 可以繼續提高到 900 分難度；若 Q6～Q10 錯兩題以上，接下來會增加「字面意思 vs. 說話者真正意圖」的對照訓練。

今天最重要的能力不是背 `someone`，而是 Listening 的這個轉變：

> **不要只問「他說了什麼？」；開始問「他為什麼要說這句話？」**

Day 18 將進入 **Part 3 三人對話 + 圖表資訊整合入門**，文法則處理高頻的 **主詞動詞一致：either/neither、along with、as well as、there is/are**。
